correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive orbit-flag chain enumeration for n=2..5 gives quotient cell counts (1); (3,3); (8,22,16); (19,121,226,125). Integral Smith ranks are (), (2), (7,15), (18,103,123), all nonzero factors equal to one, and consecutive boundaries multiply to zero. A separate signed Burnside-Lefschetz Euler calculation agrees. The labeled complexes for n>=4 are simply connected by complete-source shellability; every transposition fixes an arc vertex on two untouched graph labels, so Armstrong makes the ordinary quotient simply connected. Hurewicz/Whitehead yield S2 and a wedge of two S3, while n=2 and n=3 are point and circle directly. The verifier is self-contained except for SymPy and was executed from the actual package path.

value.rationale: The exact first four ordinary symmetric-quotient homotopy types expose a motivated first branching: the n=5 unlabeled rooted-forest quotient has two independent integral 3-sphere homotopy generators, whereas n=3,4 have single spheres and n=2 is a point. The labeled n=5 complex has 256 three-sphere homology classes; known labeled shellability cannot identify two surviving quotient classes or rule out π1/torsion. The natural unlabeled forest quotient is a meaningful finite boundary and integral classification, with no unsupported n>5 extension.
